taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's mountain hemlock review (Tesky 1992, read 2026-10-16): "usually 75 to 100 feet (23-30 m) tall"; in dense stands of the Coast Ranges "heights up to 150 feet (46 m)".

traits.foliage_ranks.note: FEIS's mountain hemlock review (Tesky 1992, read 2026-10-16): "The needles are crowded on all sides of short twigs and curved upward"; Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 63) has the leaves spreading from all sides of the branchlets.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 63, Tsuga mertensiana: "more or less curved, 15-20 mm. long, blunt-pointed".

traits.cone_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923) p. 63, Tsuga mertensiana: "cones sessile, oblong-cylindric, narrowed toward both ends, 25-75 mm. long".

generator.params.note: Western hemlock's values, changed by hand for mountain hemlock: a shorter tree (height_rate set as for whitebark pine), a narrowly conical crown under a slender drooping leader, slender drooping branches with upturned tips, needles all round the twig (FEIS, Tesky 1992). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 14 m and 30 cm across at 60 years in a stand; FEIS calls it slow-growing (Tesky 1992). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after Abrams (1923 p. 63): "light blue-green" needles; long narrow cones; furrowed red-brown bark kept from western hemlock's.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L379433), as no source read gives it.
